digest.component_or_area: criteria eval CLI and gate registry resolution
propositions: The criteria eval CLI currently rejects code-review criterion ids at preflight validation because it only checks the plan-review registry, preventing active code-review criteria from reaching the gate-aware eval resolver.
The CLI must admit code-review ids by looking them up in both plan-review and code-review effective registries and dispatch to calibrate only if the id is active in exactly one gate.
An id active in both plan-review and code-review gates must be rejected with an ambiguous error naming both gates; an id in neither must retain the existing unknown error.
The criteria eval help text must be updated to include the concrete project code-review example alongside plan-review examples.
